60720.description:
Episode 1

Koisuru Kuroyagi
The owner of the mansion was a strict man and always gave a cold response. One night, Maya is seen by him shaving her hair. The owner had a peculiar sexual fetish and was sexually aroused by shaving women's pubic hair. Maya had been in love with him since she came to the mansion, so she pulled up the hem of her skirt to show her pubic hair and asked the owner, who couldn't hide his excitement, to shave her, and he readily agreed. She lathered up shaving soap and worked her way from her waist to her thighs, around her mucous membrane and down to her pubic hair. Maya was so moved by the sight of herself that she wanted to continue.

Futarikiri no Orca Show: Kono Koi ni Oborete
Lucca is performing in a spectacular aqua show. Recently, she has been losing focus and making mistakes. The reason is clear - she is in love with Masaki, who supports her. In order to reciprocate her feelings, the other members lie to the two and introduce them to each other in an empty venue. After confessing their feelings to each other, they make love to each other. Emotionally excited, the two fall into the pool, but ascend to heaven as their bodies sink.

Episode 2

Kyuusekkin!!: Koi wa Oshiire no Naka de
That day when he hid in the closet with his childhood friend... Puru fell in love. A few years later, he sees a woman talking intimately with his childhood friend and becomes so jealous that he misses school for several days. His childhood friend comes to visit him out of concern, but when he tells her what happened, it's all a misunderstanding on Puru's part. Time passes since the day his mouth was covered by tentacles in the closet, and he finally realizes that their feelings are mutual. The two fall in love and draw close to each other.

Kemono Michi
A boy wanders into an alleyway where it is rumored that a dog-like beast lives. When Moka opens the door, the boy stands frozen, his face stiffens, and he wets himself. She invites him into her house and takes a bath with him, and the boy's crotch becomes swollen, so she decides to treat it. Once, twice... and then he begs for more. Pleasurable things await him in the alleyway he has wandered into.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

title.native: 亜人がお好きなんですね♡
title.romaji: Ajin ga Osuki nan desu ne♡

60726.description:
My Melody opens a cake shop in Mariland. After encountering a heart in the forest, strange things start happening around her. Meanwhile, Kuromi's Japanese sweets shop across the street is always empty. Kuromi searches for the secret to My Melody's cakes. My Melody and Kuromi work hard to prepare for a sweets-making contest judged by the world-famous pastry chef Pistachio. However, no one knows that this will lead to an incident that threatens the fate of Mariland.

(Source: Netflix)
synonyms: マイメロディとクロミ

title.native: My Melody & Kuromi

60732.description:
Ryou is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he’ll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryou is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You’d think he’d forget about taking it easy when he’s stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryou, he’s naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden “Eternal Youth” trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that’s only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryou to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life... Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

streamingEpisodes.title: Episode 1 - The Slow, But Dangerous, Life

60739.description:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival

60765.description:
When high schooler Mari bumps into a fellow tardy student, she's surprised to find out he's a beastfolk who's to attend her school! After all, it's not rare for beastfolk to coexist alongside humans, but it's still uncommon, with the prejudice and all. Nervous to meet one at first, Mari soon learns there's more to him than his furry exterior. In fact, the more she gets to know him, the more she finds herself drawn to him, his steadfastness, his kindheartedness, and…his body…

(Source: Yen Press)

60766.description:
Since ancient times, Dahe Shenzhou has been a land where virtue and evil have been at odds. Numerous justice-related sects have banded together to combat the evil's twelve irresponsible sects. The justice Jinyi Sect's low-level supernatural power is Li Wannian, who possesses ordinary cultivation. He wants to live a life of peace and quiet, lying flat in the Jinyi Sect and receiving a salary.

He unexpectedly learned, however, that he possessed the eternal capacity to instantly resurrect at the point of life-or-death crisis while completing a task to deal with the transfer. More significantly, he can improve his cultivation after each resurrection by receiving incentives in the form of points based on his overall performance at the time of his beheading. To put it another way, Li Wannian has to make a valiant sacrifice, and in a way that inspires and motivates others if he hopes to advance his cultivation.

title.native: 天命大主宰

60772.description:
The first fire-themed anime series in China. It mainly tells the moving story of Han Yan, the head of Feiliu Fire Station, and a group of young people including Jiang Mingsheng, Ning Wei, and Fan Haoyuan, who burn their youth and blood and fight on the front line of firefighting. Not only are there high-energy moments of fire rescue, but also the fire brigade that is extremely brave in wartime and extremely cute in leisure time, as well as fascinating suspense cases and hard-core firefighting knowledge! Show a different kind of passionate youth~

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title.native: 向火而生

60773.description:
One day, Uta and her friends find themselves invited to perform at the "Super Miracle Idol Festival," the universe's greatest idol festival held on the mysterious Aiai Island, by the coral fairy Tot. Suddenly, a mysterious monster appears, plunging the island and the world into a major crisis, and Uta and her friends are sent flying back in time. The key to overcoming this crisis lay hidden with the island's legendary goddess and with Tera, a mysterious idol-hating girl they meet on the island.

Last but not least, the Hirogaru Sky! Precure and the Wonderful Precure also make their appearance!
As they sing, dance and deliver fan-service, a kirakilala live for YOU begins!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

60774.description:
In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, ChaO follows Stephan, a mild-mannered office worker at a shipbuilding company, whose life is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what’s happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao. As her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers, an unexpected and touching romance begins to unfold.

(Source: GKIDS)
synonyms: เจา คนเล็กผจญเงือกใหญ่

title.native: ChaO

60778.description:
I'm supposed to be reading the air so I don't screw up,
I'm doing what everyone else is doing,
Why can't I get things done?

Rise Azumino, a university student, was lost in her life,
One day, guided by an invitation letter left behind by her late grandmother, she enters “Wonderland".
There she meets a girl named Alice and they begin their journey together.

Rise meets the White Rabbit, the Caterpillar, the Queen of Hearts, the Trumpeter, the Mad Hatter and the March Hare, Humpty Dumpty, the twins Tweedle Dum and Tweedle Dee, the Cheshire Cat and ......
The residents of Wonderland appear one after another in front of Rise!
And the crazy commotion that ensues!
What kind of future will Rise choose in this crazy adventure with Alice?

This adventure will surely bring a smile to your face tomorrow!

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

title.native: 不思議の国でアリスと -Dive in Wonderland-

60781.description:
A body that combines the appearance of an adorable young girl with overwhelming combat efficiency. An AI with intelligence and decision-making skills that surpass human capabilities—the perfect autonomous robot, "Alma" was created by the overlooked young genius scientists Enji and Suzume whose brilliance should've been recognized by the world! Alma calls Enji and Suzume "Father" and "Mother" which leaves them completely flustered. Regardless, the three begin a life together as a family in order to nurture Alma's powerful AI and help her evolve into the ultimate robot. Alma's curiosity has no limits as everything she sees and touches is new to her. Alma keeps Enji and Suzume on their toes with her unmatched learning capabilities and unstoppable energy as she explores the bigger world. A brand-new kind of family comedy (?!) begins!!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

60784.description:
Every night, Tomoe has a nightmare about writhing with pleasure in the guidance room, getting creampied by a student, and filming herself giving a double peace sign with a dazed look on her face. Just as she is feeling contempt for the student who is giving her lewd looks again today, Nemoto, who appears in her dreams every night, appears! When Nemoto calls Tomoe to the audiovisual room, Tomoe makes it clear that she dislikes Nemoto, but when she sees his penis, she can't contain her excitement and kneels down...!

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

60794.description:
One day, Li Wuwang suddenly awakens to find himself, as the villain, kidnapping Wan Zheng, the Holy Maiden of the Wan Chao Sect, and fleeing. Before Li Wuwang can even react, the "system" that appears before him quickly issues him a mission: strip the Destiny Points of the chosen one. Either complete the mission and survive, or fail and become an ant dying under the sword of the chosen protagonist.

(Source: Youku, translated)
synonyms: The Public Enemy of the Immortal World

title.native: 我，修仙界的公敌

60797.description: The mysterious young man Dafeng rescued Li Huamei, who was seriously ill after being plotted against. Dafeng wanted to go to Kyoto to find his senior sister and happened to be on the same road with Li Huamei. On the way, Li Huamei was shocked to find that her senior sister was the Queen Qin Zhao, and the Queen repeatedly sent assassins to kill her. In order to find out the reason, Dafeng and Li Huamei entrusted their lives to each other and fought against the enemy together. Disputes arose in the rivers and lakes, and the court struggles became more intense. The two were unknowingly involved in a treacherous conspiracy, and Dafeng was the key to solving all the mysteries...

title.native: 斗战天下
